overall_reason: A WordPress theme (The7) whose article body is consistent (18px #444 text, 34px headings, 10px rhythm on a 5px base), with a Slider Revolution header inserted on its own sizes, radii and per-layer z-index, and a theme token set the rules mostly bypass.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY passes on the article; it fails on the inserted header, and T-HARDCODE finds 91% literal colours and 640 unused theme tokens (TOK-013, TOK-006, TOK-005).

findings.evidence: The header is a Slider Revolution slide (#SR7_2_1-3-*) with its own values: pill labels at 12 and 13px, the name 'Reid Hoffman' at 23px in #000000, a 15px card radius, and link blue #0d5bba (values.1440 font_size, radius and colour examples), while the article below uses 18px #444444 text and a 20px blockquote radius.
findings.before: Header on 12, 13 and 23px text, #000000 and a 15px radius; article on 18 and 34px, #444444 and a 20px radius
findings.after: The header reads the theme's type sizes, ink and card radius (one radius for both cards)
findings.why: The two cards stacked on the first screen have different corners and inks, so the header reads as pasted on.

findings.evidence: The theme declares 789 tokens (--the7-base-color, --the7-btn-bg-color), but 3260 of 3571 colour declarations are literals, 400 colour and 400 spacing literals equal a token's value, and 640 tokens are never referenced (declarations, tokens.own_tokens_never_referenced).
findings.before: 91% literal colours beside a full theme token set
findings.after: Rules reference the --the7-* tokens; unused tokens go
findings.why: A theme colour change would miss nine rules in ten.

findings.evidence: Thirteen z-index values render (-1, 0, 1, 5, 8, 9, 10, 15, 16, 18, 20, 21, 105), one per slider layer (values.1440.ladder).
findings.after: A short layer ladder; slider layers stacked by document order
findings.why: Per-layer numbers break as soon as another overlay has to sit above the header.

findings.evidence: One heading renders at 33px beside 76 elements at 34px (values.1440.font_size near_duplicates 33/34).
findings.why: A 1px heading difference is invisible and only adds a value.

strengths: The article holds one body size (18px on 297 elements) and one heading size (34px), in one ink (#444444).
Spacing sits on a 5px base (share 0.97 against chance 0.25), with 10px reused for paragraph rhythm.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
the embedded pitch-deck slides are exhibits
T-FRAMEWORK-FIT: no framework scale (WordPress theme classes only)
